messages:
Sasha (People Ops): FYI — Taylor submitted resignation yesterday, last day 2026-04-02. Need to coordinate access removal, final pay, equipment return, and benefits/COBRA note. Can we land a plan here? :calendar:
Jordan (Manager): Thanks — TL;DR: Taylor will finish blockers by EOD 4/1, shadowing docs linked here: https://confluence.redwood/taylor-htd. Prefer access cutover on 4/2 morning after final standup.
Mike (IT): Got it. I'll book an IT ticket to collect laptop + peripherals and schedule SSO deprovisioning. ETA for pickup?
Sasha (People Ops): Taylor is remote (SF). Prefers UPS pickup on 4/3 if that's easier. Please confirm whether we can delay physical pickup until after account removal.
Mike (IT): UPS pickup on 4/3 is fine. We typically deprovision accounts the morning of the last day (4/2 09:00 PDT) then arrange pickup. That avoids reauth while shipping.
Alex (Security): Confirming: revoke GitHub personal access tokens, remove org SSO access, and rotate any shared API keys used by Taylor. Please list services where they had elevated perms.
Jordan (Manager): Taylor had write access to repos: infra/serving, infra/monitoring; read-only for analytics. Also shared access to staging Redis.
Mike (IT): Creating ticket IT-4521: Deprovision SSO, disable Okta session, remove from GitHub teams, revoke GitHub PATs via audit log. Also will rotate staging Redis password and update creds in Vault.
hr-bot: Ticket IT-4521 created by Mike. Status: open. ETA: 48 hours for full revoke and secrets rotation.
Sasha (People Ops): COBRA Q: Taylor was contractor (1099) — not benefits eligible. So no COBRA enrollment. Confirming final paycheck + any outstanding expense reimbursements will be processed by payroll cutoff 4/5.
Taylor (Contractor): Confirm I did submit last expenses yesterday. When should I expect reimbursement?
Sasha (People Ops): Payroll processes reimbursements with the next payroll cycle. For this batch expect payment by 4/10. I'll send a confirmation email once processed.
Jordan (Manager): Quick note on knowledge capture — I added a short Handover doc in Confluence and set up a 1-hr session on 4/1 11:00 with team. Taylor, can you add runbook pointers for nightly job failure recovery?
Taylor (Contractor): Yep, added runbook section and logs snippet. Also pasted the `curl` command we use to clear cache: ```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/clear-cache -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"key":"job-*"}'
```
Alex (Security): Please redact any tokens in docs. Good catch. After deprovision, rotate any tokens referenced.
Mike (IT): Noted. I'll rotate the staging Redis pw at 4/2 09:15 and update Vault. Will also remove Taylor from GitHub at 4/2 09:00; please confirm approval.
Jordan (Manager): Approved. :thumbsup:
Sasha (People Ops): Exit interview — we usually do a 30-min interview. Taylor, prefer 4/3 or 4/6?
Taylor (Contractor): 4/3 after 2pm works.
Sasha (People Ops): Scheduled and calendar invite sent (zoom link). Final checklist summary: 1) Deprovision SSO/GitHub (4/2 09:00) 2) Rotate secrets (4/2 09:15) 3) UPS pickup for laptop (4/3) 4) Final pay + reimburse by 4/10 5) Exit interview 4/3 14:00. I'll follow up post-deprovision with status.
Mike (IT): Will post updates in this thread when done and close IT-4521.
Alex (Security): Will audit logs for last 30 days and attach findings to IT ticket.
hr-bot: Reminder: add final benefits flag to HR system (contractor = no COBRA). Action logged.
Sasha (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If any blockers surface before 4/2 ping me directly. :wave:
